# Decide

The rest of this kit tells you what the options are. This page walks you to an answer — one question at a time, ending in a verdict with its reasoning recorded and dated.

!!! tip "Why the record matters more than the answer"
    The EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF all ask for
    **documented, reasoned decisions**. A classification with no
    rationale cannot be defended or sensibly reviewed later — so the
    rationale trail is not paperwork, it is the deliverable.
